name: Achilló
subtitle: Jon's Achilles rehab log
description: Private AltStore source for the Achilló rehab app. Builds are published by the app's build script.

apps.name: Achilló
apps.subtitle: Guided Achilles rehab, by ear
apps.localizedDescription: Daily post-op Achilles program: BFR, Chris's barefoot and boot-on routines, hourly quick ones, hinge ladder, imagery. Audio cues keep going with the screen locked; reminders come from the app.

versions.localizedDescription:
Reliability fixes from the second review: syncing or importing can no longer roll a finished round backward; a cleared note stays cleared; the bundled history seed applies once and never overwrites your corrections; a failed save now says so instead of pretending; notes and check-ins save instantly and flush when you leave the app.
Watch: Pause, Skip and End now reach the phone even when it was out of reach, applied at the moment you tapped, and the watch says "Phone out of reach" when that happens. Ending from the watch credits what you did while the phone slept. Finish text says Quick one done / Hips done / Round done.
Phone: Skip while paused no longer leaves the controls looking paused; the skip button says "Skip set" when that is what it does; the swipe-out pause undo is tighter (0.8 s) so a deliberate pause then switching apps stays paused.
Watch battery: the session clock kept ticking ten times a second after a session ended. It now stops when the session does.

Reopening the app mid-session now shows a card: where you were, with Resume, Restart this exercise, or End. Unfinished exercises are never credited.
Skipped exercises show as skipped (not done) in the day log; they still count toward the round.
Voice and Cues are separate switches now, with a short preview when you turn one on. The watch and home screen both say when the next quick one is due and what your interval is.
